rows.conflict: UX-01 lists five journey stages while UX-19 names الحلقة، المقاطع، الإنتاج، المراجعة، الحفظ.
rows.resolution: Use the UX-19 five-step indicator; analysis is a substate of الحلقة and choice is represented by المقاطع.

rows.conflict: Hide internal render/authorization/QA actions without weakening safety.
rows.resolution: Keep calls in the existing workflow service and invoke them behind Continue/Produce; expose only technical details when expanded.

rows.conflict: Video-first picker versus native SIRAJ package ingestion.
rows.resolution: Video file is the primary action; native project folder remains under خيارات متقدمة only.

rows.conflict: Automatic discovery versus ambiguous or unrelated nearby metadata.
rows.resolution: Auto-bind only one bounded related candidate; stop and show file/path/id/modified/hash information when ambiguous or stale.

rows.conflict: Automated QA should be automatic but the user must still see review responsibility.
rows.resolution: Run QA directly after local render, show a human-readable pass/fail message, then require full human review.

rows.conflict: Full uninterrupted review versus detailed scrubbing/frame inspection.
rows.resolution: Require uninterrupted playback first; reveal the detailed toolbar only after valid coverage.

rows.conflict: Approval and saving could be combined but receipts must remain auditable.
rows.resolution: Keep اعتماد الشورت and حفظ الشورت as separate human actions.

rows.conflict: RTL Arabic UI versus paths, hashes, timestamps, and technical identifiers.
rows.resolution: Use RTL for the main surface and LTR/selectable text inside technical details and source dialogs.

rows.conflict: Cancel must be available during active work without becoming a retry path.
rows.resolution: Show إيقاف بأمان only while a job runs; a cancelled or failed render is terminal for that attempt and has no automatic resubmission.
